descriptionLabels.ja: <InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/>長押しで力を溜められる。溜め始めると、巨大な<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【白彼岸花】</>を召喚して敵へ飛ばし、接触すると爆発する。溜めが完了すると、敵の目前へ瞬間移動して強力な斬撃を放つ。
descriptionLabels.ko: <InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/>를 길게 눌러 차지할 수 있다. 차지를 시작하면 거대한 【<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>하얀 석산화</>】를 소환해 적에게 날려 보내며, 적과 접촉하면 폭발한다. 차지가 완료되면 적의 앞으로 순간이동해 강력한 참격을 가한다.
descriptionLabels.ru: Удерживайте<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="0" LeftPadding="5"/>, чтобы зарядить атаку. В начале зарядки появляется гигантская <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Белая паучья лилия]</>: она летит к врагу и взрывается при попадании. Полностью зарядив атаку, вы телепортируетесь к врагу и наносите мощный рубящий удар.
descriptionLabels.zh-Hant: 長按<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>可以蓄力，開始蓄力時，召喚巨型<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【白石蒜花】</>飛向敵人，接觸敵人後發生爆炸。蓄力完成時， 瞬移至敵人面前並發動一次強力斬擊。
descriptionLabels.fr: Maintenez <InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/> pour charger. Dès le début de la charge, un immense <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Lys d'araignée blanc]</> est invoqué : il fonce sur l'ennemi et explose à l'impact. Une fois la charge terminée, téléportez-vous devant l'ennemi et assénez-lui une puissante attaque.
descriptionLabels.de: Halte <InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/> zum Aufladen gedrückt. Sobald das Aufladen beginnt, beschwörst du eine riesige<Character_Yellow_Decorator2> [Weiße Spinnenlilie]</>, die auf den Gegner zufliegt und bei Kontakt explodiert. Bei vollständiger Aufladung teleportierst du dich vor den Gegner und führst einen mächtigen Hieb aus.
descriptionLabels.es-ES: Mantén pulsado <InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/> para cargar. Al comenzar la carga, invoca un enorme <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Lirio de araña blanca]</> que vuela hacia el enemigo y explota al impactar. Al completar la carga, teletranspórtate frente al enemigo y ejecuta un poderoso ataque.
descriptionLabels.pt-BR: Segure<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>para carregar. Ao iniciar a carga, invoca um <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>Lírio Branco</> gigante que voa em direção ao inimigo e explode ao tocá-lo. Ao completar a carga, Soul se teleporta para a frente do inimigo e desfere um corte poderoso.
descriptionLabels.it: Tieni premuto <InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/> per caricare. All'inizio della carica, evochi un gigantesco <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>Giglio Ragno</> Bianco che vola verso il nemico ed esplode al contatto. A carica completa, ti teletrasporti davanti al nemico e sferri un potente fendente.
descriptionLabels.th: กด<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>ค้างเพื่อชาร์จพลัง เมื่อเริ่มชาร์จพลังจะเรียก<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[ดอกพลับพลึงขาว]</>ขนาดยักษ์พุ่งเข้าหาศัตรูและระเบิดเมื่อสัมผัส เมื่อชาร์จพลังเต็มจะเคลื่อนกายไปปรากฏตรงหน้าศัตรูในพริบตา แล้วฟันอย่างรุนแรงหนึ่งครั้ง
descriptionLabels.vi: Giữ<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>để tích lực. Khi bắt đầu tích lực, triệu hồi một đóa <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>Bỉ Ngạn Trắng</> khổng lồ bay về phía kẻ địch và phát nổ khi chạm vào chúng. Khi tích lực hoàn tất, dịch chuyển tới trước mặt kẻ địch và tung một đòn chém uy lực.
descriptionLabels.pt-PT: Mantém <InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/>premido para carregar. Ao começar a carregar, invocas um <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>Lírio-Aranha Branco</> gigante que voa na direção do inimigo e explode ao contacto. Com a carga completa, teletransportas-te para a frente do inimigo e desferes um golpe poderoso.
descriptionLabels.es-419: Mantén presionado <InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/> para cargar. Al comenzar la carga, invoca un enorme <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Lirio de araña blanca]</> que vuela hacia el enemigo y explota al entrar en contacto con él. Al completar la carga, teletranspórtate frente al enemigo y ejecuta un poderoso ataque.

descriptionLabels.en: Hold<InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>to charge. The next attack to hit the marked enemy deals increased damage and has increased Sha-Chi Depletion.
descriptionLabels.ja: <InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>長押しで力を溜め、離すと<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>刀の衝撃波</>を放つ。ダメージを与え、敵に<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【凶寇の印】</>を<dtv id="X393"/>段階付与する。印が付いた敵への次の一撃は、ダメージと殺気削り量が増加する。
descriptionLabels.ko: <InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>를 길게 눌러 차지하고, 손을 떼면 <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>도기 충격파</>를 날려 적에게 피해를 준다. 적에게 【<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>흉구 표식</>】을 <dtv id="X393"/>중첩 부여해 다음에 받는 공격의 피해량과 살기 감소량을 증가시킨다.
descriptionLabels.ru: Удерживайте<InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>для зарядки. Отпустите, чтобы выпустить <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>волну клинка</>, наносящую урон и накладывающую <dtv id="X393"/> заряд <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Метки истребителя разбойников]</>. Следующая атака по отмеченному врагу нанесёт больше урона и сильнее истощит Ша-Ци.
descriptionLabels.zh-Hant: 按住<InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>可蓄力，釋放後掃出<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>刀波</>，造成傷害並給敵人施加<dtv id="X393"/>層<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【凶寇標記】</>，使其受到的下一次攻擊的傷害和殺氣削減提升。
descriptionLabels.fr: Maintenez<InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>pour charger. Relâchez pour déclencher une <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>onde de lame</> qui inflige des dégâts et applique <dtv id="X393"/> cumul de <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Marque du chasseur de bandits]</> à l'ennemi. La prochaine attaque qui touche l'ennemi marqué inflige davantage de dégâts et un épuisement accru du Sha-Chi.
descriptionLabels.de: Halte <InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/> zum Aufladen gedrückt. Lasse los, um eine <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>Klingenwelle</><Character_Yellow_Decorator2> </>auszulösen, die Schaden verursacht und dem Gegner <dtv id="X393"/> Stapel<Character_Yellow_Decorator2> </><Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Banditentöter-Mal]</> zufügt. Der nächste Angriff auf den markierten Gegner verursacht erhöhten Schaden und entzieht ihm mehr Sha-Chi.
descriptionLabels.es-ES: Mantén<InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>para cargar. Suelta para ejecutar una <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>onda de hoja</> que inflige daño y aplica <dtv id="X393"/> acumulación de <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Marca cazabandidos]</> al enemigo. El siguiente ataque que golpee al enemigo marcado inflige más daño y tiene un mayor agotamiento de Sha-Chi.
descriptionLabels.pt-BR: Segure<InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>para carregar. Solte para desferir uma <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>onda laminar</> que causa dano e aplica <dtv id="X393"/> acúmulos de <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Marca do Matador de Bandidos]</> ao inimigo. O próximo ataque a atingir o inimigo marcado causa dano aumentado e tem maior Redução de Sha-Chi.
descriptionLabels.it: Tieni premuto <InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/> per caricare. Rilascia per scatenare <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>un'onda di lama</> che infligge danni e applica <dtv id="X393"/> accumuli di <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Marchio Trucida-Banditi]</> al nemico. Il prossimo attacco che colpisce il nemico marchiato infligge più danni e ha un maggiore consumo di Sha-Chi nemico.
descriptionLabels.th: กด <InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/> ค้างเพื่อสะสมพลัง ปล่อยเพื่อซัด<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>คลื่นดาบ</>สร้างความเสียหาย พร้อมผนึก <dtv id="X393"/> ชั้นของ<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[ตราโจรทมิฬ] </>ทำให้ศัตรูโดนความเสียหายและปราณสังหารจากการโจมตีครั้งถัดไปเพิ่มขึ้น
descriptionLabels.vi: Giữ<InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>để tích lực. Nhả nút để phóng ra một luồng <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>đao khí</>, gây sát thương và đặt <dtv id="X393"/> tầng <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Ấn Ký Diệt Phỉ]</> lên kẻ địch. Đòn tấn công tiếp theo trúng kẻ địch bị đánh dấu sẽ gây thêm sát thương và làm hao hụt nhiều Sát Khí hơn.
descriptionLabels.pt-PT: Mantém<InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>premidos para carregar. Solta para libertar uma <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>onda de lâminas</> que causa dano e aplica <dtv id="X393"/> acumulações de <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Marca de Mata-Bandidos]</> ao inimigo. O próximo ataque a atingir o inimigo marcado causa mais dano e maior redução de Sha-Chi.
descriptionLabels.es-419: Mantén presionados<InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>para cargar. Suéltalos para desatar una <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>onda de filo</> que inflige daño y aplica <dtv id="X393"/> acumulación de <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Marca matabandidos]</> al enemigo. El siguiente ataque que golpee al enemigo marcado inflige más daño y tiene un mayor agotamiento de Sha-Chi.

descriptionLabels.zh-Hans: <InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>发动<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>冲锋</>。持续消耗自身杀气，杀气不足时停止冲锋。
descriptionLabels.en: Press<InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>to <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>rush</> forward. The rush continuously consumes Sha-Chi and ends when Sha-Chi runs out.
descriptionLabels.ja: <InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>で<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>突進</>を発動する。自身の殺気を消費し続け、殺気が不足すると突進を停止する。
descriptionLabels.ko: <InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/> 버튼을 눌러 <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>돌진</>한다. 살기가 지속적으로 소모되며, 살기가 부족하면 돌진을 멈춘다.
descriptionLabels.ru: Нажмите<InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="0" LeftPadding="5"/>, чтобы <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>сделать рывок вперед</>. Во время рывка непрерывно расходуется Ша-Ци. Рывок прекращается, когда запас Ша-Ци иссякнет.
descriptionLabels.zh-Hant: <InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>發動<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>衝鋒</>。持續消耗自身殺氣，殺氣不足時停止衝鋒。
descriptionLabels.fr: Appuyez sur <InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/> pour vous <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>ruer</> en avant. La ruée consomme du Sha-Chi en continu et se termine quand vous n'avez plus de Sha-Chi.
descriptionLabels.de: Drücke <InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="0" LeftPadding="5"/>, um vorwärts zu <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>stürmen</>. Der Ansturm verbraucht kontinuierlich Sha-Chi und endet, sobald das Sha-Chi aufgebraucht ist.
descriptionLabels.es-ES: Pulsa<InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>para <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>cargar</> hacia delante. Esto consume Sha-Chi de forma continua y termina cuando se agota.
descriptionLabels.pt-BR: Aperte<InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>para <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>avançar</>. O avanço consome Sha-Chi continuamente e acaba quando o Sha-Chi se esgota.
descriptionLabels.it: Premi <InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/> per <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>scattare</> in avanti. La carica consuma Sha-Chi in modo continuato e termina quando questo si esaurisce.
descriptionLabels.th: กด<InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>เพื่อ<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>พุ่ง</>ไปข้างหน้า ซึ่งจะใช้ปราณสังหารอย่างต่อเนื่อง และจะหยุดเมื่อปราณสังหารไม่พอ
descriptionLabels.vi: Nhấn<InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>để <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>đột kích</> về phía trước. Động tác đột kích liên tục tiêu hao Sát Khí và kết thúc khi Sát Khí cạn kiệt.
descriptionLabels.pt-PT: Prime<InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>para <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>avanço</> em frente. A corrida consome continuamente Sha-Chi e termina quando o Sha-Chi se esgota.
descriptionLabels.es-419: Presiona<InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>para <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>avanzar</> rápidamente. El avance rápido<Character_Yellow_Decorator2> </>consume Sha-Chi de manera continua y termina cuando se agota el Sha-Chi.

descriptionLabels.zh-Hans: <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>冲锋</>过程中受到的伤害降低，若<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【强力冲锋】</>起手时受到伤害，则震开周围敌人并使得冲锋变得<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>无法防御</>。
descriptionLabels.en: Reduces damage taken during a <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>rush</>. If damage is taken during the startup of <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Mighty Rush]</>, nearby enemies are knocked back and the charge becomes <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>unblockable</>.
descriptionLabels.ja: <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>突進</>中に受けるダメージが減少する。<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【強力突進】</>の始動時にダメージを受けた場合、周囲の敵を吹き飛ばし、突進が<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>ガード不可</>となる。
descriptionLabels.ko: <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>돌진</> 중 받는 피해가 감소한다. 【<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>강력 돌진】</>을 시작할 때 피해를 입으면 주위 적을 밀쳐 내며 돌진이 <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>방어 불가</>로 바뀐다.
descriptionLabels.ru: Снижает получаемый урон во время <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>рывка</>. Если получить урон в начале <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Могучего натиска]</>, ближайших врагов отбросит, а рывок станет <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>неблокируемым</>.
descriptionLabels.zh-Hant: <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>衝鋒</>過程中受到的傷害降低，若<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【強力衝鋒】</>起手時受到傷害，則震開周圍敵人並使得衝鋒變得<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>無法防禦</>。
descriptionLabels.fr: Réduit les dégâts subis pendant une <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>ruée</>. Si des dégâts sont subis au lancement de <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Ruée puissante]</>, les ennemis à proximité sont repoussés et la charge devient <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>imblocable</>.
descriptionLabels.de: Verringert den während eines <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>Ansturms</> erlittenen Schaden. Bei Schaden während der Vorbereitungsphase von <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Mächtiger Ansturm]</> werden Gegner in der Nähe zurückgestoßen und der Ansturm kann <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>nicht geblockt</> werden.
descriptionLabels.es-ES: Reduce el daño recibido durante una <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>carga</>. Si recibes daño durante el inicio de <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Carga implacable]</>, los enemigos cercanos salen despedidos y la carga <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>no se puede bloquear</>.
descriptionLabels.pt-BR: Reduz o dano sofrido durante um <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>avanço</>. Se o dano for sofrido durante o início de um <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Avanço Poderoso]</>, inimigos próximos são empurrados e a investida se torna <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>impossível de bloquear</>.
descriptionLabels.it: Riduce i danni subiti durante uno <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>scatto</>. Se subisci danni all'avvio della <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Carica Poderoso]</>, i nemici vicini vengono respinti e la carica diventa <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>inbloccabile.</>
descriptionLabels.th: ลดความเสียหายที่ได้รับระหว่าง<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>พุ่งทะลวง</> หากถูกโจมตีขณะเริ่มใช้<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[พุ่งทะลวง]</> จะกระแทกศัตรูรอบตัวให้ถอยและทำให้การพุ่งครั้งนี้<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>ไม่สามารถป้องกันได้</>
descriptionLabels.vi: Giảm sát thương nhận vào trong lúc <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>đột kích</>. Nếu chịu sát thương trong khi bắt đầu kích hoạt <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Đột Kích Uy Mãnh]</>, kẻ địch lân cận sẽ bị hất lùi và đòn xung kích sẽ <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>không thể bị chặn</>.
descriptionLabels.pt-PT: Reduz o dano sofrido durante uma <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>avanço</>. Se o dano for sofrido durante o arranque do <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Avanço Possante]</>, os inimigos próximos são empurrados para trás e a carga torna-se <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>impossível de bloquear</>.
descriptionLabels.es-419: Reduce el daño recibido durante una <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>embestida</>. Si se recibe daño al iniciar la <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Embestida poderosa]</>, los enemigos cercanos serán empujados hacia atrás y la embestida <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>no se puede bloquear</>.

descriptionLabels.zh-Hant: 施展絕技<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【天煞破敵】</>，<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>完美閃避</>紅光技能，或<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>完美格擋</>藍光技能後，可銜接<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/><InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/>後撤並進行連續強力遠程攻擊。

descriptionLabels.vi: Sau khi sử dụng <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Thiên Sát Phá Địch]</>, thi triển một lần <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>Né Tránh Hoàn Hảo</> Đòn Ánh Đỏ, hoặc <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>Đỡ Đòn Hoàn Hảo</> một Đòn Ánh Xanh, nhấn<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/><InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/>để rút lui và thi triển loạt chiêu thức tầm xa đầy uy lực.
descriptionLabels.pt-PT: Após usar <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Saque de Tiansha]</>, executar uma <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>Esquiva perfeita</> contra um Ataque de clarão vermelho ou <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>aparar</> um Ataque de clarão azul, prime<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/><InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/>para recuar e desferir uma série de poderosos ataques à distância.

descriptionLabels.pt-BR: Aperte<InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>para consumir toda a <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Aura Funesta]</> e lançar uma rajada de pares de machados conjurados que <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>são direcionados</> ao inimigo em que a mira está travada.
descriptionLabels.it: Premi <InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/> per consumare tutta l'<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Aura Funesta] </>e scagliare una raffica di asce evocate che <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>inseguono</> il nemico agganciato.
descriptionLabels.th: <InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/> ใช้<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>ไอสังหาร</>ทั้งหมดเพื่อขว้างขวานคู่จำแลงจำนวนมาก ให้<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>ติดตาม</>ศัตรูที่ล็อกเป้า
descriptionLabels.vi: Nhấn<InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>để tiêu hao toàn bộ <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Hung Khí]</> và ném ra lượng lớn song việt huyễn hóa có thể <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>truy kích</> kẻ địch bị khóa mục tiêu.
descriptionLabels.pt-PT: Prime<InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>para consumir toda a <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Aura Nefasta]</> e lançar machados gémeos conjurados que <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>encontram</> o inimigo fixado.
descriptionLabels.es-419: Presiona <InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>para consumir toda la <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Aura siniestra]</> y lanzar un aluvión de hachas gemelas conjuradas que <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>rastrean</> al enemigo fijado.

descriptionLabels.zh-Hans: 连招中可按住<InputAction id="LightAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>蓄势，随后发动一套交错切割的快速连斩，将妖气浸入伤口，把敌人身上的<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【妖气侵蚀】</>异化为<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【幽蓝侵蚀】</>，引爆时削减更多杀气。

descriptionLabels.ja: 連続攻撃中に<InputAction id="LightAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>を長押しで力を溜めると、交差する素早い連続斬撃を繰り出す。さらに、傷口から妖気を浸透させ、敵に付与された<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【妖気侵蝕】</>を<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【幽藍侵蝕】</>に変化させる。爆発時には、敵の殺気をより多く削る。
descriptionLabels.ko: 연계 공격 중 <InputAction id="LightAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/>를 길게 눌러 힘을 모으면, 빠르게 교차하며 적을 연속으로 베어 낸다. 이때 요기를 상처에 침투시켜 적에게 걸린 【<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>요기 침식</>】을 【<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>짙푸른 침식</>】으로 변화시킨다. 이를 폭발시키면 적의 살기를 더 많이 감소시킨다.
descriptionLabels.ru: Во время комбо удерживайте<InputAction id="LightAttack" height="26" RightPadding="0" LeftPadding="5"/>, чтобы накопить заряд, затем обрушьте стремительную череду перекрёстных ударов, вливая ауру демона в раны. <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Эрозия ауры демона]</> на враге превращается в <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Лазурную эрозию]</> и при взрыве снимает больше Ша-Ци.
descriptionLabels.zh-Hant: 連招中可按住<InputAction id="LightAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>蓄勢，隨後發動一套交錯切割的快速連斬，將妖氣浸入傷口，把敵人身上的<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【妖氣侵蝕】</>異化為<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【幽藍侵蝕】</>，引爆時削減更多殺氣。
descriptionLabels.fr: Pendant un combo, maintenez <InputAction id="LightAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/> pour charger, puis déchaînez une série rapide de tailles entrecroisées qui imprègnent les plaies d'aura démoniaque, transformant l'<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Érosion démoniaque]</> de l'ennemi en <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Érosion azurée],</> laquelle épuise davantage de Sha-Chi lorsqu'elle éclate.
descriptionLabels.de: Halte während einer Kombo <InputAction id="LightAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/> zum Aufladen gedrückt und entfessle anschließend eine schnelle Folge sich kreuzender Hiebe. Sie treiben Dämonenaura in die Wunden und verwandeln die <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Dämonenaura-Erosion]</> am Gegner in <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Azur-Erosion]</>, die bei ihrer Eruption mehr Sha-Chi entzieht.
descriptionLabels.es-ES: En un combo, mantén pulsado<InputAction id="LightAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>para cargar y desata una rápida sucesión de cortes entrecruzados que impregna las heridas de aura demoníaca, transformando la <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Erosión demoníaca]</> del enemigo en <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Erosión azur]</>, que agota más Sha-Chi al detonar.

descriptionLabels.vi: Trong chuỗi liên kích, có thể giữ <InputAction id="LightAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/> để tích thế, sau đó tung ra một loạt trảm kích nhanh đan chéo xé nát; Yêu Khí tẩm vào vết thương, biến <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Yêu Khí Xâm Thực]</> trên người kẻ địch thành <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[U Lam Xâm Thực]</>, khi kích nổ sẽ tiêu hao nhiều Sát Khí hơn.

descriptionLabels.en: During a combo, hold <InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/> to charge, then unleash a rapid series of sweeping, spinning Sha-Chi slashes that drive Fiend-Aura deep into the bone, transforming <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Fiend-Aura Erosion] </>on the enemy into <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Crimson Erosion]</>, which deals increased damage when it erupts.
descriptionLabels.ja: 連続攻撃中に<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>を長押しで力を溜めると、横薙ぎと高速回転を織り交ぜた殺気の連続斬撃を繰り出す。さらに、妖気を骨髄まで抉り込むように浸透させ、敵に付与された<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【妖気侵蝕】</>を<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【深紅侵蝕】</>に変化させる。爆発時には、より大きなダメージを与える。
descriptionLabels.ko: 연계 공격 중 <InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/>를 길게 눌러 힘을 모으면, 빠르게 회전하며 주변을 휩쓰는 살기 참격을 펼친다. 이때 요기를 적의 골수 깊숙이 파고들게 해 【<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>요기 침식</>】을 【<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>심홍 침식</>】으로 변화시킨다. 이를 폭발시키면 더 큰 피해를 준다.
descriptionLabels.ru: Во время комбо удерживайте<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="0" LeftPadding="5"/>, чтобы накопить заряд, затем обрушьте стремительную череду размашистых крутящихся ударов Ша-Ци, которые впиливают ауру демона в кости.<Character_Yellow_Decorator2> </><Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Эрозия Ауры Демона]</><Character_Yellow_Decorator2> </>на враге превращается в<Character_Yellow_Decorator2> [Багровую эрозию]</><Character_Yellow_Decorator2> </>и при взрыве наносит больше урона.
descriptionLabels.zh-Hant: 連招中可按住<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>蓄勢，隨後發動一套橫掃疾旋的殺氣斬擊，將妖氣鋸入骨髓，把敵人身上的<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【妖氣侵蝕】</>異化為<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【深紅侵蝕】</>，引爆時造成更多傷害。
descriptionLabels.fr: Pendant un combo, maintenez <InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/> pour charger, puis déchaînez une série rapide de tailles de Sha-Chi amples et tournoyantes qui font pénétrer l'aura démoniaque jusqu'aux os, transformant l'<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Érosion démoniaque]</><Character_Yellow_Decorator2> </>de l'ennemi en<Character_Yellow_Decorator2> </><Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Érosion rouge]</>, laquelle inflige davantage de dégâts lorsqu'elle éclate.
descriptionLabels.de: Halte während einer Kombo <InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/> zum Aufladen gedrückt und entfessle anschließend eine schnelle Folge weit ausholender, wirbelnder Sha-Chi-Hiebe. Sie treiben Dämonenaura tief in die Knochen und verwandeln die<Character_Yellow_Decorator2> [Dämonenaura-Erosion] </>am Gegner in <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Karmesin-Erosion]</>, die bei ihrer Eruption mehr Schaden verursacht.
descriptionLabels.es-ES: Durante un combo, mantén pulsado <InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/> para cargar y luego desata una rápida sucesión de amplios tajos giratorios de Sha-Chi que infunden aura demoníaca hasta los huesos y transforman la <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Erosión demoníaca]</><Character_Yellow_Decorator2> </>del enemigo en <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Erosión roja]</>, que inflige más daño al estallar.
descriptionLabels.pt-BR: Durante um combo, segure <InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/> para carregar e, em seguida, desfira rapidamente uma série de cortes giratórios e amplos de Sha-Chi que fazem a Aura Hedionda penetrar profundamente nos ossos, transformando a <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Erosão de Aura Hedionda]</> no inimigo em <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Erosão Carmesim]</>, que causa mais dano quando entra em erupção.
descriptionLabels.it: Durante una combo, tieni premuto <InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/> per caricare, quindi scatena una rapida serie di fendenti di Sha-Chi ampi e rotanti che spingono l'Aura Diabolica fin dentro l'osso, trasformando l'<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Erosione dell'Aura Diabolica] </>sul nemico in<Character_Yellow_Decorator2> [Erosione Cremisi]</>, che all'eruzione infligge più danni.
descriptionLabels.th: ระหว่างคอมโบ กด<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>ค้างเพื่อชาร์จพลัง จากนั้นปล่อยชุดฟันปราณสังหารที่กวาดและหมุนอย่างรวดเร็ว ฝังไออสูรเข้าไปถึงไขกระดูก เปลี่ยน<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[ไออสูรกัดกร่อน]</>บนตัวศัตรูเป็น<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[มลทินชาดกัดกร่อน]</> ซึ่งเมื่อปะทุจะสร้างความเสียหายมากขึ้น
descriptionLabels.vi: Trong chuỗi liên kích, có thể giữ <InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/> để tích thế, sau đó tung ra một loạt trảm kích Sát Khí quét ngang xoáy nhanh; Yêu Khí bị cưa vào tận tủy xương, <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Yêu Khí Xâm Thực]</> trên người kẻ địch biến thành <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Thâm Hồng Xâm Thực]</>, khi kích nổ sẽ gây sát thương lớn hơn.
descriptionLabels.pt-PT: Durante um combo, mantenha <InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/> premido para carregar e, em seguida, desfira rapidamente uma série de golpes giratórios e amplos de Sha-Chi que fazem a Aura Maligna penetrar profundamente nos ossos, transformando a <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Erosão da Aura Maligna]</> no inimigo em <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Erosão Carmesim]</>, que causa mais dano quando irrompe.
descriptionLabels.es-419: Durante un combo, Mantén presionado <InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/> para cargar y luego desata una rápida serie de amplios cortes giratorios de Sha-Chi que infunden aura demoníaca hasta los huesos y transforman la <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Erosión del aura demoníaca]</> del enemigo en <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Erosión roja]</>, que inflige más daño al estallar.

descriptionLabels.zh-Hans: <InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>可以蓄力，发动亡命蓄斩，蓄力期间受到的伤害全部计为<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>临时损血</>，如果命中敌人，会回复在此期间受到的<dtv id="X132"/>的<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>临时损血</>，对人偶、金身、幻体无效。
descriptionLabels.en: Hold<InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>to charge Reckless Cleave. All damage taken during the charge is converted into <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>Recoverable HP</>. If the strike hits an enemy, <dtv id="X132"/> of the <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>Recoverable HP</> accumulated during the charge is restored. Has no effect on Puppets, Golden Bodies, or Phantom Bodies.
descriptionLabels.ja: <InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>で力を溜め、亡命蓄斬を繰り出す。力を溜めている間に受けたダメージはすべて<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>仮ダメージ</>として計算され、敵に命中した場合、その間に受けた<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>仮ダメージ</>の<dtv id="X132"/>を回復する。人形、金身、幻体には無効。
descriptionLabels.ko: <InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>를 길게 눌러 차지하면 ‘망명 축참’을 발동한다. 차지하는 동안 받는 피해는 모두 <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>일시적 체력 손실</>로 처리된다. 공격이 적에게 적중하면, 차지 중 입은 <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>일시적 체력 손실</>의 <dtv id="X132"/>만큼을 회복한다. 인형, 금신, 환체에는 적용되지 않는다.
descriptionLabels.ru: Удерживайте<InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="0" LeftPadding="5"/>, чтобы зарядить Безрассудный удар. Весь урон, полученный во время зарядки, превращается в <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>восстанавливаемое здоровье</>. При попадании по врагу возвращается <dtv id="X132"/> от<Character_Yellow_Decorator2> восстанавливаемого здоровья</>, накопленного во время зарядки. Не действует на Марионеток, Золотые тела и Фантомные тела.
descriptionLabels.zh-Hant: <InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>可以蓄力，發動亡命蓄斬，蓄力期間受到的傷害全部計為<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>臨時損血</>，如果命中敵人，會回復在此期間受到的<dtv id="X132"/>的<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>臨時損血</>，對人偶、金身和幻體無效。
descriptionLabels.fr: Maintenez<InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>pour charger la Taille téméraire. Tous les dégâts subis pendant la charge sont convertis en <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>PV récupérables</>. Si l'attaque touche un ennemi, <dtv id="X132"/> des <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>PV récupérables</> accumulés pendant la charge sont restaurés. Sans effet sur les marionnettes, les corps d'or et les corps spectraux.
descriptionLabels.de: Halte <InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/> gedrückt, um Rücksichtsloses Spalten aufzuladen. Der gesamte während des Aufladens erlittene Schaden wird in <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>wiederherstellbare Gesundheit</> umgewandelt. Trifft der Schlag einen Gegner, werden <dtv id="X132"/> der während des Aufladens angesammelten <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>wiederherstellbaren Gesundheit</> wiederhergestellt. Hat keine Wirkung auf Puppen, Goldkörper oder Phantomkörper.
descriptionLabels.es-ES: Mantén<InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>para cargar el Corte Temerario. Todo el daño recibido durante la carga se convierte en <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>salud recuperable</>. Si el golpe alcanza a un enemigo, se restaura <dtv id="X132"/> de la <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>salud recuperable</> acumulada durante la carga. No tiene efecto en marionetas, cuerpos dorados ni cuerpos espectrales.
descriptionLabels.pt-BR: Segure<InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>para carregar [Cisão Imprudente]. Todo dano recebido durante a carga é convertido em <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>PV Recuperável</>. Se o golpe atingir o inimigo, recupera <dtv id="X132"/> do <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>PV Recuperável</> recebido durante a carga. Esta recuperação não ativa contra Marionetes, Corpos Dourados ou Corpos Fantasmas.
descriptionLabels.it: Tieni premuto <InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/> per caricare Colpo Avventato. Tutti i danni subiti durante la carica vengono convertiti in <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>Salute Recuperabile</>. Se il colpo va a segno, ripristini <dtv id="X132"/> della <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>Salute Recuperabile </>accumulata durante la carica. Non ha effetto su Marionette, Corpi Dorati o Corpi Illusori.
descriptionLabels.th: <InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/> ชาร์จพลังเพื่อใช้ท่าฟาดฟันถวายชีวิต ความเสียหายทั้งหมดที่ได้รับระหว่างชาร์จพลังจะนับเป็น<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>พลังชีพที่สูญเสียชั่วคราว</> หากโจมตีถูกศัตรู จะฟื้น<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>พลังชีพชั่วคราวที่เสีย</>ไประหว่างนั้นจำนวน <dtv id="X132"/> แต่ไม่มีผลต่อหุ่นเชิด ร่างทอง และร่างมายา
descriptionLabels.vi: Giữ<InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>để tích lực cho Vong Mạng Tụ Trảm. Mọi sát thương phải nhận trong khi tích lực được chuyển thành <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>Sinh Lực Có Thể Phục Hồi</>. Nếu đòn này đánh trúng kẻ địch, phục hồi <dtv id="X132"/> lượng <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>Sinh Lực Có Thể Phục Hồi</> tích lũy trong khi tích lực. Không có hiệu lực với Hình Nhân, Kim Thân hay Huyễn Thể.
descriptionLabels.pt-PT: Mantém<InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>premidos para carregar Golpe Temerário. Todo o dano sofrido durante a carga é convertido em <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>Vida recuperável</>. Se o golpe atingir um inimigo, recuperas <dtv id="X132"/> da <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>Vida recuperável</> acumulada durante a carga. Não tem efeito em Marionetas, Corpos Dourados ou Corpos Fantasma.
descriptionLabels.es-419: Mantén presionado<InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>para cargar el Corte temerario. Todo el daño recibido durante la carga se convierte en <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>salud recuperable</>. Si el golpe alcanza a un enemigo, se restaura <dtv id="X132"/> de la <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>salud recuperable</> acumulada durante la carga. No tiene efecto en marionetas, cuerpos dorados ni cuerpos espectrales.

<InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>进入<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【布局】</>姿态，在即将受到攻击时施展，可向后<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>遁形闪现</>，并召唤<dtv id="X566"/>把<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【悬浮飞剑】</>进行反击。

descriptionLabels.en:
Press <InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/> to enter<Character_Yellow_Decorator2> [Grand Design] </>stance. If activated just before an incoming attack, you will <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>Teleport </>backward and summon <dtv id="X566"/><Character_Yellow_Decorator2> [Floating Swords] </>to counterattack.
Hold <InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/> to maintain<Character_Yellow_Decorator2> [Grand Design]</>. Sha-Chi is gradually consumed while in this stance.  
If attacked while in<Character_Yellow_Decorator2> [Grand Design] </>stance, all remaining Sha-Chi is consumed to negate the damage and dodge backward, ending <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Grand Design]</>.  
<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Grand Design] </>does not interrupt your current combo.  
While in <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Grand Design] </>stance, press <InputAction id="LightAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/> to consume a set amount of Sha-Chi and summon <dtv id="X564"/> <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>Phantom Firearms</> to attack enemies. Can only be used once per<Character_Yellow_Decorator2> [Grand Design] </>stance.
descriptionLabels.ja:
<InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>で<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【布陣】</>の構えを取る。敵の攻撃を受ける直前に発動すると、<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>後方へ瞬間移動して攻撃を回避</>し、<dtv id="X566"/>本の<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【浮遊飛剣】</>を召喚して反撃する。

<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【布陣】</>の構え中に攻撃を受けると、残りの殺気をすべて消費してその攻撃のダメージを無効化し、後方へ回避する。同時に<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【布陣】</>の構えが解除される。
<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【布陣】</>を発動しても、進行中の連撃を中断しない。
<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【布陣】</>の構え中に<InputAction id="LightAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>を押すと、一定量の殺気を消費して<dtv id="X564"/>丁の<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>幻の火縄銃</>を召喚し、敵を攻撃する。<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【布陣】</>の構え1回につき、1度だけ発動できる。

【<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>설계</>】 상태에서 공격을 받으면 현재 남은 살기를 모두 소모해 해당 피해를 무효화하고 뒤로 회피하며, 동시에 【<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>설계</>】 상태가 해제된다.

descriptionLabels.zh-Hans: 长按<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>可以蓄力，开始蓄力时，召唤巨型<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【白石蒜花】</>飞向敌人，接触敌人后发生爆炸。蓄力完成时，瞬移至敌人面前并发动一次强力斩击。
descriptionLabels.en: Hold <InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/>to charge. When charging begins, summon a giant <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[White Spider Lily]</> that flies toward the enemy and explodes on contact. When fully charged, teleport in front of the enemy and unleash a powerful slash.
descriptionLabels.ja: <InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/>長押しで力を溜められる。溜め始めると、巨大な<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【白彼岸花】</>を召喚して敵へ飛ばし、接触すると爆発する。溜めが完了すると、敵の目前へ瞬間移動して強力な斬撃を放つ。
descriptionLabels.ko: <InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/>를 길게 눌러 차지할 수 있다. 차지를 시작하면 거대한 【<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>하얀 석산화</>】를 소환해 적에게 날려 보내며, 적과 접촉하면 폭발한다. 차지가 완료되면 적의 앞으로 순간이동해 강력한 참격을 가한다.
descriptionLabels.ru: Удерживайте<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="0" LeftPadding="5"/>, чтобы зарядить атаку. В начале зарядки появляется гигантская <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Белая паучья лилия]</>: она летит к врагу и взрывается при попадании. Полностью зарядив атаку, вы телепортируетесь к врагу и наносите мощный рубящий удар.
descriptionLabels.zh-Hant: 長按<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>可以蓄力，開始蓄力時，召喚巨型<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【白石蒜花】</>飛向敵人，接觸敵人後發生爆炸。蓄力完成時， 瞬移至敵人面前並發動一次強力斬擊。
descriptionLabels.fr: Maintenez <InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/> pour charger. Dès le début de la charge, un immense <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Lys d'araignée blanc]</> est invoqué : il fonce sur l'ennemi et explose à l'impact. Une fois la charge terminée, téléportez-vous devant l'ennemi et assénez-lui une puissante attaque.
descriptionLabels.de: Halte <InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/> zum Aufladen gedrückt. Sobald das Aufladen beginnt, beschwörst du eine riesige<Character_Yellow_Decorator2> [Weiße Spinnenlilie]</>, die auf den Gegner zufliegt und bei Kontakt explodiert. Bei vollständiger Aufladung teleportierst du dich vor den Gegner und führst einen mächtigen Hieb aus.
descriptionLabels.es-ES: Mantén pulsado <InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/> para cargar. Al comenzar la carga, invoca un enorme <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Lirio de araña blanca]</> que vuela hacia el enemigo y explota al impactar. Al completar la carga, teletranspórtate frente al enemigo y ejecuta un poderoso ataque.
descriptionLabels.pt-BR: Segure<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>para carregar. Ao iniciar a carga, invoca um <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>Lírio Branco</> gigante que voa em direção ao inimigo e explode ao tocá-lo. Ao completar a carga, Soul se teleporta para a frente do inimigo e desfere um corte poderoso.
descriptionLabels.it: Tieni premuto <InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/> per caricare. All'inizio della carica, evochi un gigantesco <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>Giglio Ragno</> Bianco che vola verso il nemico ed esplode al contatto. A carica completa, ti teletrasporti davanti al nemico e sferri un potente fendente.
descriptionLabels.th: กด<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>ค้างเพื่อชาร์จพลัง เมื่อเริ่มชาร์จพลังจะเรียก<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[ดอกพลับพลึงขาว]</>ขนาดยักษ์พุ่งเข้าหาศัตรูและระเบิดเมื่อสัมผัส เมื่อชาร์จพลังเต็มจะเคลื่อนกายไปปรากฏตรงหน้าศัตรูในพริบตา แล้วฟันอย่างรุนแรงหนึ่งครั้ง
descriptionLabels.vi: Giữ<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>để tích lực. Khi bắt đầu tích lực, triệu hồi một đóa <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>Bỉ Ngạn Trắng</> khổng lồ bay về phía kẻ địch và phát nổ khi chạm vào chúng. Khi tích lực hoàn tất, dịch chuyển tới trước mặt kẻ địch và tung một đòn chém uy lực.
descriptionLabels.pt-PT: Mantém <InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/>premido para carregar. Ao começar a carregar, invocas um <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>Lírio-Aranha Branco</> gigante que voa na direção do inimigo e explode ao contacto. Com a carga completa, teletransportas-te para a frente do inimigo e desferes um golpe poderoso.
descriptionLabels.es-419: Mantén presionado <InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/> para cargar. Al comenzar la carga, invoca un enorme <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Lirio de araña blanca]</> que vuela hacia el enemigo y explota al entrar en contacto con él. Al completar la carga, teletranspórtate frente al enemigo y ejecuta un poderoso ataque.

descriptionLabels.zh-Hans: 连招中可按住<InputAction id="LightAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>蓄势，随后发动一套交错切割的快速连斩，将妖气浸入伤口，把敌人身上的<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【妖气侵蚀】</>异化为<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【幽蓝侵蚀】</>，引爆时削减更多杀气。
descriptionLabels.en: During a combo, hold <InputAction id="LightAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/> to charge, then unleash a rapid series of crossing slashes that infuse Fiend-Aura into the wounds, transforming <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Fiend-Aura Erosion] </>on the enemy into <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Azure Erosion],</> which depletes more Sha-Chi when it erupts.
descriptionLabels.ja: 連続攻撃中に<InputAction id="LightAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>を長押しで力を溜めると、交差する素早い連続斬撃を繰り出す。さらに、傷口から妖気を浸透させ、敵に付与された<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【妖気侵蝕】</>を<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【幽藍侵蝕】</>に変化させる。爆発時には、敵の殺気をより多く削る。
descriptionLabels.ko: 연계 공격 중 <InputAction id="LightAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/>를 길게 눌러 힘을 모으면, 빠르게 교차하며 적을 연속으로 베어 낸다. 이때 요기를 상처에 침투시켜 적에게 걸린 【<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>요기 침식</>】을 【<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>짙푸른 침식</>】으로 변화시킨다. 이를 폭발시키면 적의 살기를 더 많이 감소시킨다.
descriptionLabels.ru: Во время комбо удерживайте<InputAction id="LightAttack" height="26" RightPadding="0" LeftPadding="5"/>, чтобы накопить заряд, затем обрушьте стремительную череду перекрёстных ударов, вливая ауру демона в раны. <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Эрозия ауры демона]</> на враге превращается в <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Лазурную эрозию]</> и при взрыве снимает больше Ша-Ци.
descriptionLabels.zh-Hant: 連招中可按住<InputAction id="LightAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>蓄勢，隨後發動一套交錯切割的快速連斬，將妖氣浸入傷口，把敵人身上的<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【妖氣侵蝕】</>異化為<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【幽藍侵蝕】</>，引爆時削減更多殺氣。
descriptionLabels.fr: Pendant un combo, maintenez <InputAction id="LightAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/> pour charger, puis déchaînez une série rapide de tailles entrecroisées qui imprègnent les plaies d'aura démoniaque, transformant l'<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Érosion démoniaque]</> de l'ennemi en <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Érosion azurée],</> laquelle épuise davantage de Sha-Chi lorsqu'elle éclate.
descriptionLabels.de: Halte während einer Kombo <InputAction id="LightAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/> zum Aufladen gedrückt und entfessle anschließend eine schnelle Folge sich kreuzender Hiebe. Sie treiben Dämonenaura in die Wunden und verwandeln die <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Dämonenaura-Erosion]</> am Gegner in <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Azur-Erosion]</>, die bei ihrer Eruption mehr Sha-Chi entzieht.
descriptionLabels.es-ES: En un combo, mantén pulsado<InputAction id="LightAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>para cargar y desata una rápida sucesión de cortes entrecruzados que impregna las heridas de aura demoníaca, transformando la <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Erosión demoníaca]</> del enemigo en <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Erosión azur]</>, que agota más Sha-Chi al detonar.
descriptionLabels.pt-BR: Durante um combo, segure <InputAction id="LightAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/> para carregar e, em seguida, desfira rapidamente uma série de cortes cruzados que infundem a Aura Hedionda nas feridas, transformando a <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Erosão de Aura Hedionda]</> no inimigo em <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Erosão Azul-Celeste]</>, que consome mais Sha-Chi quando entra em erupção.
descriptionLabels.it: Durante una combo, tieni premuto <InputAction id="LightAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/> per caricare, quindi scatena una rapida serie di fendenti incrociati che infondono l'Aura Diabolica nelle ferite, trasformando l'<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Erosione dell'Aura Diabolica]</> sul nemico in <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Erosione Azzurra]</>, che all'eruzione consuma più Sha-Chi.
descriptionLabels.th: ระหว่างคอมโบ กด<InputAction id="LightAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>ค้างเพื่อชาร์จพลัง จากนั้นปล่อยชุดฟันไขว้ต่อเนื่องอย่างรวดเร็ว แทรกไออสูรเข้าไปในบาดแผล เปลี่ยน<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[ไออสูรกัดกร่อน]</>บนตัวศัตรูเป็น<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[ครามสะกดวิญญาณ]</> ซึ่งเมื่อปะทุจะลดปราณสังหารได้มากขึ้น
descriptionLabels.vi: Trong chuỗi liên kích, có thể giữ <InputAction id="LightAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/> để tích thế, sau đó tung ra một loạt trảm kích nhanh đan chéo xé nát; Yêu Khí tẩm vào vết thương, biến <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Yêu Khí Xâm Thực]</> trên người kẻ địch thành <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[U Lam Xâm Thực]</>, khi kích nổ sẽ tiêu hao nhiều Sát Khí hơn.
descriptionLabels.pt-PT: Durante um combo, mantém <InputAction id="LightAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/> premido para carregar e, em seguida, desfere rapidamente uma série de golpes cruzados que infundem a Aura Maligna nas feridas, transformando a <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Erosão da Aura Maligna]</> no inimigo em <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Erosão Azul-Celeste]</>, que consome mais Sha-Chi quando entra em erupção.
descriptionLabels.es-419: Durante un combo, Mantén presionado <InputAction id="LightAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/> para cargar y ejecutar una rápida cadena de cortes cruzados que empapa las heridas con aura demoníaca, transformando la<Character_Yellow_Decorator2> </><Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Erosión del aura demoníaca]</><Character_Yellow_Decorator2> </>del enemigo en <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Erosión azur]</>, que reduce más Sha-Chi al estallar.

descriptionLabels.ja: <InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>で力を溜め、亡命蓄斬を繰り出す。力を溜めている間に受けたダメージはすべて<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>仮ダメージ</>として計算され、敵に命中した場合、その間に受けた<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>仮ダメージ</>の<dtv id="X132"/>を回復する。人形、金身、幻体には無効。
descriptionLabels.ko: <InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>를 길게 눌러 차지하면 ‘망명 축참’을 발동한다. 차지하는 동안 받는 피해는 모두 <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>일시적 체력 손실</>로 처리된다. 공격이 적에게 적중하면, 차지 중 입은 <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>일시적 체력 손실</>의 <dtv id="X132"/>만큼을 회복한다. 인형, 금신, 환체에는 적용되지 않는다.
descriptionLabels.ru: Удерживайте<InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="0" LeftPadding="5"/>, чтобы зарядить Безрассудный удар. Не действует на Марионеток, Золотые тела и Фантомные тела.
descriptionLabels.zh-Hant: <InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>可以蓄力，發動亡命蓄斬，蓄力期間受到的傷害全部計為<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>臨時損血</>，如果命中敵人，會回復在此期間受到的<dtv id="X132"/>的<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>臨時損血</>，對人偶、金身和幻體無效。
descriptionLabels.fr: Maintenez<InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>pour charger la Taille téméraire. Sans effet sur les marionnettes, les corps d'or et les corps spectraux.
descriptionLabels.de: Halte <InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/> gedrückt, um Rücksichtsloses Spalten aufzuladen. descriptionLabels.es-ES: Mantén<InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>para cargar el Corte Temerario. No tiene efecto en marionetas, cuerpos dorados ni cuerpos espectrales.
descriptionLabels.pt-BR: Segure<InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>para carregar [Cisão Imprudente]. descriptionLabels.it: Tieni premuto <InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/> per caricare Colpo Avventato. descriptionLabels.vi: Giữ<InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>để tích lực cho Vong Mạng Tụ Trảm. Không có hiệu lực với Hình Nhân, Kim Thân hay Huyễn Thể.

descriptionLabels.zh-Hans: <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【布局】</>姿态下，<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>消耗一定杀气召唤<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>幻化巨锤</>攻击敌人，每次<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【布局】</>仅可施展一次。
descriptionLabels.en: While in<Character_Yellow_Decorator2> [Grand Design] </>stance, press <InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/> to consume a set amount of Sha-Chi and summon <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>a phantom great hammer</> to attack enemies. Can only be used once per <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Grand Design]</> stance.
descriptionLabels.ja: <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【布陣】</>の構え中に<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>を押すと、一定量の殺気を消費して<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>幻の大槌</>を召喚し、敵を攻撃する。<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【布陣】</>の構え1回につき、1度だけ発動できる。
descriptionLabels.ko: 【<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>설계</>】 상태에서 <InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/>를 누르면 일정량의 살기를 소모해 거대한 <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>환영 망치</>를 소환하여 적을 공격한다. 【<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>설계</>】 상태를 취할 때마다 한 번만 사용할 수 있다.
descriptionLabels.ru: Нажмите <InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="0" LeftPadding="0"/>, находясь в стойке <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Великий замысел]</>, чтобы потратить определённое количество Ша-Ци и призвать <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>Фантомный Боевой Молот</> для атаки противников. Его можно использовать только один раз за время действия <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Великого замысла]</>.
descriptionLabels.zh-Hant: <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【佈局】</>姿態下，<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>消耗一定殺氣召喚<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>幻化巨錘</>攻擊敵人，每次<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【佈局】</>僅可施展一次。
descriptionLabels.fr: En posture <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Grand dessein]</> appuyez sur<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>pour consommer une quantité définie de Sha-Chi et invoquer <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>un grand marteau spectral</> qui attaque les ennemis. Une seule utilisation par posture <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Grand dessein]</>.
descriptionLabels.de: Drücke in der Haltung<Character_Yellow_Decorator2> [Großer Plan] </><InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="0" LeftPadding="5"/>, um eine bestimmte Menge Sha-Chi zu verbrauchen und <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>einen Phantom-Großhammer </>zu beschwören, der Gegner angreift. Kann pro Einnahme der Haltung <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Großer Plan]</> nur einmal eingesetzt werden.
descriptionLabels.es-ES: En la postura<Character_Yellow_Decorator2> [Gran diseño],</> pulsa <InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/> para consumir una cantidad determinada de Sha-Chi e invocar <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>un gran martillo espectral</> que ataque a los enemigos. Solo se puede usar una vez por cada postura <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Gran diseño]</>.
descriptionLabels.pt-BR: Na postura <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Grande Arranjo]</>, aperte <InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/> para consumir uma quantidade fixa de Sha-Chi e invocar <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>um martelo gigante fantasma </>que ataca os inimigos. Só pode ser usado uma vez por ativação de <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Grande Arranjo]</>.
descriptionLabels.it: Mentre sei nella posizione <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Grande Progetto]</>, premi <InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/> per consumare una determinata quantità di Sha-Chi ed evocare <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>un grande Martello Illusorio</> che attacca i nemici. Questo attacco può essere usato una sola volta per ogni attivazione di <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Grande Progetto]</>.
descriptionLabels.th: ขณะอยู่ในท่า<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[วางหมาก]</> กด<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>เพื่อใช้ปราณสังหารจำนวนหนึ่งและอัญเชิญ<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>ค้อนยักษ์มายา</>โจมตีศัตรู โดยใช้ได้เพียงหนึ่งครั้งต่อการเข้าสู่<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[วางหมาก]</>แต่ละครั้ง
descriptionLabels.vi: Trong thế <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Bố Cục]</>, nhấn <InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/> để tiêu hao một lượng Sát Khí nhất định và triệu hồi <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>Huyễn Hóa Cự Chùy</> tấn công kẻ địch. Mỗi lần <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Bố Cục]</> chỉ có thể thi triển một lần.
descriptionLabels.pt-PT: Na postura <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Grande Desígnio]</>, prime <InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/> para consumir uma quantidade de Sha-Chi e invocar um <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>martelo gigante fantasma</> que ataca os inimigos. Só pode ser usado uma vez por ativação de <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Grande Desígnio]</>.
descriptionLabels.es-419: En la postura <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Gran diseño]</>, presiona <InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/> para consumir una cantidad determinada de Sha-Chi e invocar <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>un gran martillo espectral</> que ataque a los enemigos.
